hints.title: Prime Sieve Generation
hints.text: Precompute all primes up to n using a sieve.

hints.title: Prefix Sums of Primes
hints.text: Compute cumulative sums of the consecutive primes to quickly obtain sum of any slice.

hints.title: Maximize Sequence Length
hints.text: Iterate over prime sequences in decreasing order of length. The first sum that is prime and <= n is optimal.
